data.job_description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

Position: Manager – GL Close/FP&A/Investment Accounting/Reg Reporting/Financial Accounting

Experience: 10+ Years

Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Manager with 8-10 years of progressive accounting and financial planning experience to lead financial operations and financial transformation projects. The successful candidate will oversee general ledger close processes, month-end accounting operations, investment accounting, and financial planning activities. The Manager will lead finance transformation initiatives focused on General Ledger (GL) Close, FP&A, and Record to Report operations within Financial Services firms. This role requires a strategic manager with extensive process expertise and proficiency in technology platforms (e.g., Oracle, Workday, Adaptive, PowerApps) to drive significant value. The Manager will leverage process improvement methodologies and technology as enablers to achieve operational efficiency and enhance accuracy through best-in-class processes and tools.

Key Responsibilities:

• Chart of Accounts Mapping & Redesign: Design, implement, optimize Chart of Accounts structures that align with reporting requirements. Lead CoA mapping during ERP implementations, ensuring seamless data translation. Develop dimensional hierarchies and account coding standards to support multi-entity consolidation and reporting.
• Management of GL Close Activities: Lead and manage the complete GL close and month-end accounting cycles, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant financial statement preparation. Review journal entries, reconciliation procedures and account analyses to ensure financial statement integrity. Coordinate inter-company eliminations, consolidation adjustments and balance sheet reconciliations.
• Investment Accounting Operations Oversee investment accounting operations, including security transactions, valuations, reconciliations, and reporting. Prepare investment performance reports, reconcile investment holdings and manage regulatory compliance for investment portfolios.
• Transformation Initiatives: Support strategic finance transformation programs, including ERP implementations, system migrations, and digital process redesign.
• Comprehensive As-Is Assessments: Conduct detailed assessments of current Finance processes, including planning, budgeting, reporting, and finance close, utilize process mapping and modelling tools viz. Visio, ARIS and identify areas for improvement.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including IT, Tax, Treasury, and Operations, to drive integrated finance transformation and foster a culture of continuous improvement.
• Technology Transformation: Establish automated close processes and eliminate legacy systems through process redesign. Implement advanced accounting platforms viz. Workday, Workiva, Blackline, Tagetik, Trintech and spearhead finance transformation initiatives.

Key Skills:

• GL Close: General Ledger Management, Chart of Accounts Design and Month end close processes
• Investment Accounting: Strong experience in Investment Accounting, NAV calculations and securities management with valuation expertise
• Deep Understanding of FP&A Processes: Extensive knowledge of FP&A processes, including forecasting, budgeting, finance close, intercompany accounting, financial reporting standards, and management reporting.
• Finance Transformation: Proven experience in conducting As-Is and To-Be process assessments, process redesign and continuous improvement methodologies.
• Finance Systems Proficiency: Significant experience with Finance Systems such as Oracle EPM, Anaplan, Adaptive, Workiva, Workday, Blackline, Trintech, Tagetik and designing operating models that integrate people, processes, and technology.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Demonstrated experience in stakeholder engagement, facilitating workshops, and translating complex business needs into actionable solutions.

Education:

• Domain Expertise: Strong exposure to working in the Financial Services domain across Banking, Insurance, Asset Management, and Capital Markets.
• Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business Administration. Advanced degrees (MBA or equivalent) are preferred. B.Tech or Engineering graduates with relevant work experience in finance or financial systems.

Experience Requirements:

• Extensive Experience: 10+ years of experience in finance operations, accounting, or transformation roles.
• Proven Track Record: A successful history of driving finance process improvements, optimizing close cycles, implementing automation, and ensuring compliance in GL Close, FP&A, and R2R functions.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!

Passion, excitement & global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage - the combination of our next-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease - no matter where they are in the world.

What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!

Who we are:

Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high-stakes, high-value payments in higher education. We’ve since scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.

Today we support more than 4,900+ clients across the global education, healthcare, travel & B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries & territories and more than 140 currencies.

With over 1,200 global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 12 offices world-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.a

Job Description

At Flywire, we are hiring our first Credit Risk Manager based in Bangalore or Pune. In this role, you will be a key member of the credit risk team, leading the tactical execution of credit policies, managing a portfolio of accounts, and leveraging data-driven insights to safeguard the company’s financial health.

We are seeking a versatile professional who can analyze complex financial statements in depth, partner with Analytics on model automation initiatives, and effectively manage case queues—while balancing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

What You’ll Do:

• Execute the Strategy: Implement and refine the global credit risk framework across our key verticals (Education, Healthcare, Travel, and B2B), ensuring localized and vertical nuances are captured and addressed.
• Lead the Underwriting Engine: Manage the end-to-end credit assessment process for new and existing clients. You will be the final touchpoint for complex deals, ensuring deep due diligence and a balanced approach to risk and growth.
• Advanced Analytics & Modeling: Be a "hands-on" contributor to our risk infrastructure. You will leverage SQL and Python to analyze payment trends, validate credit scoring models, and improve the accuracy of our risk decisioning.
• Continuous Account Monitoring: Own the lifecycle of the merchant relationship. You will architect and manage real-time account monitoring protocols, tracking processing and settlement patterns and financial health markers to ensure our exposure remains within appetite.
• Portfolio Health & Early Warning: Actively monitor the global portfolio for early warning signals of deteriorating credit. When a signal is triggered, you will lead the immediate investigation and propose remediation or collateralization strategies.

Qualifications

Here's what we are looking for:

• The Experienced Analyst: You bring a deep understanding of credit risk, specifically within Payments, Fintech, or Banking. You understand merchant credit, settlement risk, and the complexities of global fund flows.
• Educational & Professional Foundation: * A Master’s Degree in Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field with 5+ years of relevant experience.
• OR a Bachelor’s Degree with 8+ years of relevant experience in a credit risk or underwriting leadership role.
• Technically Proficient: You are highly proficient with data. You have advanced skills in SQL or Python and are comfortable using BI tools (Tableau, Looker) to visualize portfolio risk.
• The Decision Maker: You are comfortable making high-stakes decisions in a fast-paced environment.
• Collaborative Communicator: You can translate complex credit concepts into actionable insights for Sales and Product teams, acting as a key partner.

Additional Information

What We Offer:

• Competitive compensation
• Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
• Flying Start - Our immersive Global Induction Program (Meet our Execs & Global Teams)
• Work with brilliant people that will keep you on your toes, learn more about their journeys by checking out #InsideFlywire on social media
• Dynamic & Global Team (we have been collaborating virtually for years!)
• Wellbeing Programs (Mental Health, Wellness, Yoga/Pilates/HIIT Classes) with Global FlyMates
• Be a meaningful part in our success - every FlyMate makes an impact
• Competitive time off including FlyBetter Days to volunteer in a cause you believe in and
• Digital Disconnect Days!
• Great Talent & Development Programs (Managers Taking Flight – for new or aspiring managers!)
Submit today and get started!

We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet with different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager, Peers on the team, the VP of the department, and a skills assessment. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go-to” person for any questions.

Flywire is an equal opportunity employer. With over 40 nationalities across 14 different offices diversity, gender equality, and inclusion are at the core of our people agenda. We believe our FlyMates are our greatest asset, and we’re excited to watch our unique culture evolve with each new hire.

ABOUT UNI SEOUL

Uni Seoul is India's fastest-growing Korean-inspired lifestyle brand, bringing Seoul's vibrant culture to everyday life across India. With 12 stores across Pune, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Nashik, and Ahmedabad — and a fast-

growing D2C platform at uniseoul.in — we are building a structured business backed by marquee investors.

We're now scaling aggressively and building the internal systems that will take us from 12 to 50+ stores. The finance

function is being built from the ground up — and this is one of the earliest, most foundational hires within it.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As Accountant – Finance Operations, you will be the execution engine of our finance team. Working closely with the

4. To maintain chart of accounts as per the headquarters guidelines

B. Regulatory Compliance:

1. To prepare various regulatory statutory returns on a weekly, monthly, quarterly, half yearly and on annual basis and submit the same with the regulator on a timely manner.

2. To ensure that the other regulatory certification and declaration such as FDI Certificate, Statutory Auditor’s Certificate are filed with the regulator’s on a timely basis.

3. To support in preparation of data for RBI related queries and Information sought from accounting.

4. To support the Regulator’s inspection from accounting and reporting standpoint.

5. Preparation of Liquidity Coverage Ratios & CRAR on monthly basis.

7. To prepare and facilitate various regulatory reports for ALCO meetings.

8. To ensure all the relevant and applicable compliances are complied with and closed on a timely manner in the Compliance tool.

C. Audit:

1. To prepare the required balance sheet & P&L schedules as required during the Statutory audit.

2. To work closely with auditors and ensure that the financials contain all relevant disclosures applicable to the Company.

3. To review the audit observations and Management Letter and take it to the relevant team for response and closure.

4. To monitor and ensure the Internal Control Systems are in place as per the Mercedes- Benz Guidelines.

5. To ensure that the Internal Control on Financial Reporting are in place by demonstrating and documenting the controls in place.

6. To prepare presentations for various meetings related to audits like audit committee and board.

1. To review the statutory remittances carried out by Taxation and HR department and provide accounting clearance and facilitate nil / insignificant open items.

2. To review the inter-co accounting and confirmation process of all the inter-companies and ensure timely reporting with nil or identified reconciliation items.

3. To review and approve the daily clearing entries.

3. To train and educate the SSC to comply with both the IFRS and Ind AS Accounting Standards.

4. To liaison with Treasury Centre of India (TCI) for various day to day and operation topics.

5. To provide various accounting and financial related inputs to TCI for getting the Credit Rating letters.

6. To work closely with TCI in monitoring the cash flow position of the Company and facilitate them with the latest ALM and LCR submission to take meaning decisions.

7. To support other functions of the Company as and when the demand arises.

F. To automate the various manual process to ensure accuracy and increase efficiency.

Main Accountabilities

A. Preparation of financial statements

1. To prepare & Review the Balance sheet, Profit & Loss statements, and schedules under IFRS for month end closure.

2. Review the inputs into the monthly reporting tool and ensure smooth closure of monthly reporting.

3. To prepare financial statements as per IND AS for regulatory reporting.

4. To maintain chart of accounts as per the headquarters guidelines

5. To prepare presentation on Financial Performance of the Company for Board and Audit Committees.

B. Regulatory Compliance:

1. To prepare various regulatory statutory returns on a weekly, monthly, quarterly, half yearly and on annual basis and submit the same with the regulator on a timely manner.

2. To ensure that the other regulatory certification and declaration such as FDI Certificate, Statutory Auditor’s Certificate are filed with the regulator’s on a timely basis.

3. To support in preparation of data for RBI related queries and Information sought from accounting.

4. To support the Regulator’s inspection from accounting and reporting standpoint.

5. Preparation of Liquidity Coverage Ratios & CRAR on monthly basis.

6. To prepare input for disclosures of various statutory financial and related information on the website of the Company on a timely manner.

7. To prepare and facilitate various regulatory reports for ALCO meetings.

8. To ensure all the relevant and applicable compliances are complied with and closed on a timely manner in the Compliance tool.

C. Audit:

1. To prepare the required balance sheet & P&L schedules as required during the Statutory audit.

2. To work closely with auditors and ensure that the financials contain all relevant disclosures applicable to the Company.

3. To review the audit observations and Management Letter and take it to the relevant team for response and closure.

4. To monitor and ensure the Internal Control Systems are in place as per the Mercedes- Benz Guidelines.

5. To ensure that the Internal Control on Financial Reporting are in place by demonstrating and documenting the controls in place.

6. To prepare presentations for various meetings related to audits like audit committee and board.

D. Accounting Reconciliations:

1. To review the statutory remittances carried out by Taxation and HR department and provide accounting clearance and facilitate nil / insignificant open items.

2. To review the inter-co accounting and confirmation process of all the inter-companies and ensure timely reporting with nil or identified reconciliation items.

3. To review and approve the daily clearing entries.

4. To ensure closure of BRS open items related to accounting.

5. To review and approve daily WFS ( wholesale system) interface reconciliations.

6. To ensure resolution of errors in WFS batch file.

7. To recommend for accounting approvals from CAO in special cases related to accounting.

8. To prepare wholesale system reconciliation.

9. To prepare workings and raise the invoices to intercompany for various transactions.

10. Reconciliation of TDS related to dealers.

11. To prepare the dealer balances confirmation and ensure that the same is received on time in coordination with wholesale team.

E. Liaison with Shared Service Centre and Treasury Centre and other support activities:

1. To closely work with the SSC team for ensuring proper, quality and timely submission of financials with HQ.

2. To review the performance of SSC and validate the head count justification.

3. To train and educate the SSC to comply with both the IFRS and Ind AS Accounting Standards.

4. To liaison with Treasury Centre of India (TCI) for various day to day and operation topics.

5. To provide various accounting and financial related inputs to TCI for getting the Credit Rating letters.

6. To work closely with TCI in monitoring the cash flow position of the Company and facilitate them with the latest ALM and LCR submission to take meaning decisions.

7. To support other functions of the Company as and when the demand arises.
Qualifications

Qualification:

1. Education & Work experience
• Bachelor Degree or equivalent in Commerce.
• Postgraduate / Professional Degree in area of responsibility (Qualified CA).
• Working knowledge of regulatory environment for NBFC and Financial Service.
• Work experience: 3+ years in various areas of financial accounting including Accounting Standards (IGAAP & IFRS), Audits, Corporate Law, RBI-NBFC regulations, SEBI, etc.

2. Critical and soft skills knowledge
• Experience in preparation of financials both under Ind AS and IFRS.
• Experience in NBFCs / Financial Service.
• Experience in handling various audits and regulator inspections.
• Experience in handling various regulatory returns.
• Experience in monitoring the Internal Control System and ICOFR.

3. Competencies
• RBI Regulation knowledge is must.
• Strong working knowledge of MS Excel & MS Power Point is a must.
• Ability to analyze, understand and interpret data and coherently communicate the inference.
• Strong communications skills, both written and verbal
• Strong technical, analytical and problem solving skills.
• Understanding of the importance of attention to detail and organization
• Very good prioritization skills to balance key priorities
• Strategic planning, and people management, Managing performance and profitability approach.
• Integrity, Passion, Discipline, Respect

Role: Director of Finance & Compliance Pune
Experience: 8-10 years

About the role:

The Director of Finance & Compliance is a critical leadership position accountable for overseeing the organizations entire financial ecosystem. This individual will ensure the integrity of financial operations guarantee absolute statutory compliance lead strategic financial reporting and serve as the primary liaison between internal leadership and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Operations & Strategic Accounting (25%)
• Team Oversight: Lead the finance team in managing day-to-day accounting including journal entries reconciliations and general ledger integrity.
• Process Leadership: Ensure accurate processing of payroll vendor payments and statutory deductions (TDS PF ESI).
• Financial Closures: Supervise month-end and year-end closures ensuring high-quality preparation of financial statements.
• Budgeting & Grants: Set processes for budget projections fund utilization tracking and complex grant-related accounting for donor requirements.
• Banking: Maintain governance over bank accounts manage payment controls and lead banking partner relationships.

2. Compliance Governance & Audit Management (25%)
• Statutory Excellence: Ensure full compliance with Income Tax GST TDS PF and other applicable laws.
• Reporting: Oversee the preparation and timely filing of all routine statutory returns.
• Audit Leadership: Manage relationships with statutory donor and internal auditors; ensure smooth and timely audit closures.
• Donor Compliance: Oversee the end-to-end donor lifecycle including grant onboarding utilization certificates (UCs) and specialized reporting.

3. Financial Analysis & Stakeholder Management (30%)
• Systems Design: Implement comprehensive tracking systems for donor and project-specific finances to ensure transparency for all stakeholders.
• Strategic Insights: Develop monthly MIS reports financial dashboards and cash-flow forecasts to support Board-level decision-making.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Vertical Heads to manage financial projections and optimize risk management across the organization.
• External Liaison: Serve as the primary point of contact for banks auditors vendors and regulatory bodies.
• Board Engagement: Prepare quarterly reports and provide strategic recommendations to the Finance Subcommittee and the Board.

4. Team Leadership & Process Innovation (20%)
• Mentorship: Recruit manage and mentor the finance team fostering a culture of ownership and continuous capacity building.
• Control Strengthening: Continuously improve internal controls and workflows to increase efficiency and reduce operational risks.
• Documentation Standards: Drive high standards for record-keeping and organizational transparency.

Requirements

Education & Experience
• Qualifications: Chartered Accountant (CA) or MBA in Finance with a proven leadership track record.
• Professional Background: 810 years of experience with significant expertise in managing financial operations for mid-sized organizations.
• Sector Knowledge: Strong preference for candidates with experience in Non-Profits and FCRA compliance .
• Communication: Demonstrated ability to present complex financial data to Board members and senior stakeholders.
• Technical Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial modeling (creating dashboards and scenario planning tools).
• Communication: Exceptional written and oral English; functional knowledge of the regional language is preferred.

data.job_title: Chartered Accountant - Transfer Pricing - Consulting Firm
data.job_description:
As a Manager in the SBU Transfer Pricing team, your role will involve working on engagements and teams of varying sizes depending on the client/project. To qualify for this position, you should meet the following requirements:

- Be a Qualified Chartered Accountant with 2-8 years of relevant experience
- Demonstrate innovative and critical thinking in managing projects
- Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Have strong analytical and numerical skills
- Exhibit well-rounded commercial and economic awareness, understanding of financial markets, and a passion for client servicing
- Show proficiency in number crunching, have an excellent eye for detail, and be efficient in MS Office and report writing
- Be motivated, creative, and decisive in problem-solving
- Take ownership and responsibility of clients/tasks delegated

Your responsibilities as a Manager will include:

- Reviewing and finalizing transfer pricing documentation reports
- Identifying international transactions, computing arm's length prices, selecting appropriate methods, and preparing transfer pricing study reports
- Completing transfer pricing assignments including benchmarking studies for multinational clients
- Managing a team of Associates and Interns working on specific clients within the industry
- Assisting clients in transfer pricing planning
- Expanding opportunities with existing clients and acting on referrals related to the Service Line
- Conducting economic and comparability analyses using Indian and foreign databases
- Preparing and reviewing technical submissions for assessments and appellate levels
- Strategizing and representing the client's case before Tax Officers/Appellate levels
- Taking complete ownership of assigned engagements
- Coordinating with other Managers/Associate Directors for assignment planning and management
- Providing high-quality services and work products that exceed client expectations
- Managing client relationships
- Developing strong working relationships with colleagues across service lines and PwC locations

Expertise in Transfer Pricing, a good knowledge of OECD TP Guidelines, and familiarity with transfer pricing regulations of developed countries are essential for this role.
